Now look at this. The nineteen-seventies. Arnold. Franco. Ferrigno. That raw, thick, three-dimensional look — it feels like a lost art. It's the difference between a CGI explosion… and real dynamite."

Open conversational, like you're talking to a friend

Slow down on "But something's missing… isn't it?" — let it land

Hit "real dynamite" with weight — that line should feel almost physical

Don't rush — the pauses are part of the delivery

2–3 audio samples of previous narration work (YouTube videos preferred)

The required test read above (record fresh — don't send a generic demo)

Your weekly availability and turnaround time

title: YouTube Thumbnail Designer for Faceless Fitness Channel
description:
I'm hiring a long-term thumbnail designer for my faceless YouTube channel focused on old-school bodybuilding, Golden Era training methods, and the hidden history of muscle building (Arnold Schwarzenegger, Franco Columbu, Frank Zane era).This is a weekly recurring role. Thumbnails are arguably the #1 driver of growth on YouTube — so I'm looking for someone who treats this as a craft, not a templated quick-job.

About the Channel:

Niche: Old-school bodybuilding history, Golden Era training, fitness mythology

Style: Faceless / narration-driven storytelling

Tone: Dramatic, authoritative, slightly gritty — History Channel meets fitness deep-dive

Video length: 9–12 minutes per video

Upload schedule: 1 thumbnail per week to start (scaling to 2/week within 3 months)

Reference channels for thumbnail style I want to match:

Magnates Media (dramatic, high-contrast, iconic faces)

Iceberg Hill (cinematic, moody, layered)

Bodybuilding-niche channels with bold archival photography + heavy text contrast

The Thumbnail Style I'm Looking For:

? Bold archival photography — dramatic black-and-white or color-graded Golden Era bodybuilder shots

? High-contrast text overlays — punchy, readable on mobile at small sizes

? Emotional / dramatic compositions — viewers should feel something at first glance

? Cinematic color grading — moody, warm, gritty — not flat or oversaturated

? Strong focal point — one face or one object that dominates the frame

? Consistent visual identity — viewers should recognize my thumbnails after 5 videos

?? Styles that won't be a fit:

Generic stock photo + Arial text overlays

Cluttered "MrBeast clone" thumbnails with 5 objects fighting for attention

Cheap Canva templates

Anything that looks like a generic fitness Instagram post

What You'll Be Doing Each Week:

You'll receive:

The video title and topic

A short creative brief (tone, key visual element, text to include)

Your deliverables:

3 thumbnail concepts per video (different compositions / angles)

1280 x 720 px, under 2 MB, JPG or PNG

Source files (PSD or layered Figma) in case I need edits later

Mobile preview check — confirm legibility at 320px width

Delivered within 48 hours of receiving brief

Up to 2 free revisions included per video

Requirements:? Minimum 2 years of YouTube thumbnail design experience

? Portfolio with at least 5 thumbnails for monetized YouTube channels (share links to videos so I can see CTR context)

? Proficient in Photoshop (or equivalent — Figma, Affinity, Photopea)

? Strong photo manipulation skills — cutouts, compositing, color grading

? Skilled with archival / vintage photography enhancement (1970s bodybuilding imagery)

? Excellent typography sense — knows when text helps vs. clutters

? Reliable turnaround (48 hours max for first draft)

? Open to direction without ego

What I'm NOT Looking For:

? Designers who only do Instagram posts / social media graphics

? AI-generated thumbnails as the final deliverable (AI can be a tool, not the output)

? Anyone using only free Canva templates

? Designers juggling 20+ clients (I need my weekly turnaround prioritized)Compensation:

$25 USD per finished thumbnail set (3 concepts + final delivery) to start

Pay increases as the channel grows — I commit to revisiting rates every 10 videos based on channel performance

Guaranteed weekly work once trial is complete

Bonus structure when videos hit view milestones (details discussed in interview)

Trial Process:

Apply with portfolio + a short note on why you'd be a fit

Top 3 candidates get a paid trial design — I'll send a real video brief and you deliver 3 thumbnail concepts ($10 paid for the trial, regardless of outcome)

Best design gets the full first video at standard rate

If the first thumbnail performs well, we lock in a recurring weekly arrangement

To Apply, Send Me:

Portfolio link showing at least 5 YouTube thumbnails you've designed (Behance, Dribbble, or PDF)

Links to 2-3 live YouTube videos using your thumbnails (so I can see CTR context)

A 2-3 sentence note on why this niche/style interests you

Your software setup (Photoshop, Figma, etc.)

Your weekly availability and turnaround time

Your typical workflow (do you do research, mockups, A/B variations?)

Applications without portfolio links will be ignored.

Why Work With Me:

I pay on time, every time (Wise/PayPal, fast turnaround)

I give clear direction and visual references

I commit to long-term partnerships and growing rates with the channel

I respect your craft — thumbnails drive the channel, you're not a commodity

Let's build a thumbnail identity that makes this channel instantly recognizable.

title: Sales Manager
description:
Pex Life Records LLC: Our Vision for Transformative Music



Pex Life Records is an independent label where urban music meets personal development. Founded by Wilmarck, we create high-quality tracks that resonate with the motivation of Tony Robbins, blended with the commercial sound of artists like Kanye West and Drake. Our music is purpose-driven, focusing on critical life areas: health, financial literacy, peak performance, and spirituality.



You will be joining a brand with a strong, engaged audience of over 1,000
 subscribers and 20,
 followers. Your work will directly contribute to inspiring and uplifting thousands through music.-----The Role: Drive Revenue, Build a Team, Shape a Brand



We are seeking a highly motivated Music Manager to lead our sales, operations, and team development. This is a pivotal role for a professional ready to commit to a 45-50 hour/week position that offers substantial commission potential and a clear path to high earnings.



Key Areas of Impact:

Sales & Business Development: Lead client acquisition by pitching proposals to songwriting job boards and driving profits to achieve ambitious sales targets.

Team Leadership: Recruit, hire, train, and inspire contractors and staff to ensure stellar performance and successful new releases.

Operations & Finance: Manage contracts, maintain essential financial records (bookkeeping), and ensure compliance and seamless communication across all stakeholders.

Customer Experience: Be the face of the company, creating memorable customer experiences, explaining product/service prices, and handling key inquiries.



Compensation & Uncapped Earning Potential



This is a performance-driven role with a clear path to significant monthly income through our incentive program.

Base & Growth: The hourly rate starts at $2.81 USD plus commission. The initial 10 hours/week commitment quickly scales up to 45 hours/week within 45 days, allowing for a rapid increase in base earnings.

Monthly Compensation Range: $505–$900 Guaranteed Base + Generous Commission.



Compensation Structure by Target Revenue Goal:

Achieve $1,200 Minimum: Guaranteed Monthly Base: $675 Minimum. Commission Rate: 10% on qualifying sales. Enhanced Benefits Package: 13th Month Pay, Internet Costs Reimbursement, Profit Sharing, PhilHealth Reimbursement.

Achieve $2,400 Minimum: Guaranteed Monthly Base: $900 Minimum. Commission Rate: 15% on qualifying sales. Enhanced Benefits Package: Social Security System & Pag-IBIG Fund Reimbursement, 50% HMO Expenses, Profit Sharing.



Flexibility and Structure:



100% Remote Position: Work from anywhere.

Core Availability: Sunday–Thursday, 6:30 PM EST – 3:00 AM EST.

Work/Life Balance: We offer Flexible Scheduling (choose your working days/hours) and Job Sharing options.

Prospect Response Disclaimer: Maintain key client relationships by being available for 3-5 quick, 5–15 minute responses per week within a designated 8-hour window (e.g., 3:00 PM – 11:00 PM EST).



What We're Looking For (Skills & Qualities)



We need a relentless executor with an independent spirit and high integrity.

Essential: Superior proposal writing, persistence, time management, and strong English speaking/writing skills.

Ideal Candidate: Flexible, eager to learn, competitive, and receptive to constructive criticism.



Your Path to Full-Time: The Paid Audition



We skip the traditional hiring steps and go straight to evaluating your work. The process is designed to be fair, fast, and merit-based:

1 Submit your proposal.

2 Pass a screening exercise.

3 Participate in an interview.

4 Top candidates are selected for a paid audition to ensure a mutual fit before a full-time offer is extended.

If you are ready to be a crucial leader in a high-growth, mission-driven music company, apply now!



Application Instructions:



Demonstrate your expertise in sales management (client acquisition, appointment setting, and closing calls) in your proposal. To ensure you've read these details, please begin your proposal with the phrase "purple elephant."

description:
Hey — quick intro before the details.



We're a DTC ecommerce brand running paid ads on
, Instagram, and TikTok. We're scaling our testing volume and need a reliable editor to help us turn scripts, UGC, and product footage into polished ads — consistently, week after week.

This isn't a one-off gig. If we work well together, this becomes ongoing weekly work with clear briefs, fast feedback, and room to grow as we scale spend.



What you'll be doing



Each week, you'll take our scripts, voiceovers, and raw footage, and turn them into ad creatives ready to run on paid social.

That includes:



Cutting new ads from supplied scripts + UGC, product, and B-roll footage

Creating 3-5 variations off our winners (new hooks, openers, CTAs)

Adding captions, overlays, B-roll inserts, SFX, music, and pattern interrupts

Matching the style and pacing of our top-performing ads (we'll share examples)

Delivering platform-ready files (9:16 for TikTok/Reels, 1:1 for Feed, etc.)

Handling revisions quickly — ideally within 24-48 hours



You won't be writing scripts or sourcing footage. We provide the brief, the assets, and clear direction. Your job is to execute the edit.



What we're looking for



Some experience editing ecommerce, UGC, or direct-response style ads (even a few examples is fine)

Understands the basics of ad pacing — hooks, fast cuts, captions, retention

Bonus if you understand metrics like hook rate, hold rate, or CTR — but not required. We'll teach you what matters as we go.

Scripts written for direct response

Voiceovers when needed

Raw UGC, product footage, and B-roll

Editing instructions and reference ads for every brief

Clear, specific feedback — no vague notes



What we offer



Consistent work — multiple ads per week, ongoing

Long-term collaboration — we'd rather build with one good editor than juggle five

Clear briefs — you'll always know what we want

Performance feedback — we'll tell you which edits won and why, so you sharpen over time

Rate growth — as we scale spend, top performers get more volume and better rates



How to apply

Send us:



2-3 examples of ad-style edits you've done (ecommerce, UGC, or DR — links are fine)

Your editing tool (CapCut, Premiere, Final Cut, etc.)

Typical turnaround for a 30-60 second ad with one round of revisions

Your rate — per ad, per hour, or per week (whatever you prefer)

If your work and rate look like a fit, we'll send over a paid trial project — one real ad with full brief, footage, and script. It's how we confirm style, pacing, and communication match before committing to ongoing work. Editors who do well on the trial move straight into our weekly rotation.

title: Land Acquisitions VA — Discovery Calls & CRM — US Real Estate — $10/hr — 10 hrs/week. With $50 Bonus
description:
About the role:

We're a small US-based land wholesaling company. We send 1,500 outbound texts per day to landowners in the Southeast US, and we need an experienced VA to handle the next step in our funnel: discovery calls with sellers who reply, and accurate CRM updates after each call. This is a phone-heavy role, not a typing role.



Approximately 10 hours per week, Monday through Friday only (US federal holidays off), during US Central Time business hours (roughly 9am-4pm CT = 10pm-5am Manila). Pay is $10/hour paid weekly via Wise or PayPal, tracked through Time Doctor for the first 30-60 days. After the trial period and once trust is established, we may convert you to a flat weekly salary of $
/week with no time tracking. Performance bonuses available on top of base pay: $50 per closed deal that originated from your discovery call, with a path to graduated commission structures as you grow into the role over 6-12 months. 90-day trial-to-perm with potential to grow into a full-time acquisitions seat as our lead volume scales.



What you'll be doing:

You'll be making outbound discovery calls to landowners who have indicated interest via text. Each call is 15-30 minutes. Your job is to follow our discovery script, ask the qualifying questions, build rapport with the seller, and capture clean notes — NOT to make offers or close deals. Those calls go to the owner.

After each call, you'll update our CRM (Stride) with structured notes, set the next-action stage, schedule any callbacks, and flag motivated-seller signals for owner review. We provide an Otter.ai account for call recording and transcription — you don't need to bring your own. Every call must be recorded and uploaded so the owner can spot-check your work and coach you weekly.



Typical daily flow: 

2-3 hours, 5-10 outbound dial attempts per session, 4-8 connected discovery calls, 30 minutes of CRM updates and recording uploads after.

Requirements — please don't apply if you don't meet these



1+ year experience as an acquisitions or dispositions VA for a US real estate investor or wholesaler. Land experience is a strong plus; single-family residential is fine.



Fluent, clear English with minimal accent. Our sellers are rural southerners in Alabama, Tennessee, Kentucky — they'll hang up on anyone they have trouble understanding.



Comfort on the phone. You will spend half your work time talking to strangers about their property. If you prefer typing-only work, this isn't for you.



CRM experience — Stride preferred, but Podio, REI BlackBook, Salesforce, GoHighLevel, or any deal-board CRM is fine. You should know what a deal stage is and how to log a contact's notes without being told twice.

Reliable home setup: noise-canceling headset, fast internet (25+ Mbps), quiet room. Have this on day one — please don't say "I'll get one."



Willingness to work US Central Time hours, Monday-Friday only (graveyard shift in Manila). US federal holidays off. This is non-negotiable.



Familiarity with Time Doctor or similar time-tracking software (we provide the account).

Comfortable using Otter.ai for call recording and transcription (we provide the account).



How to apply

Please send the following in your application — applications missing any of these will not be reviewed:



A 60-second voice introduction (audio file or unlisted YouTube link). Tell us your name, your real estate VA experience, and one example of a tough discovery call you handled well. We need to hear how you sound on the phone.

Names of 1-2 previous US real estate clients you've worked for. We will ask for references if we shortlist you.

Your typical daily schedule in Manila time and confirmation you can work the US Central Time window above.

What CRM(s) you've used and how long.

title: Cold Caller for AI Startup (B2B / North America) - $3/hr + Bonuses
description:
Hi everyone, I'm Asad, founder of Avidra, a small AI startup based in Toronto, Canada. We're building an AI receptionist that answers calls for small trade businesses in North America (plumbers, HVAC techs, electricians) when the owner can't pick up.



I'm looking for a part-time outbound caller to help us reach our first 100 customers. This is long-term ongoing work, not a one-off gig. I want to find someone I can grow with.



WHAT YOU'LL DO DAILY:

- Make 80-100 outbound calls per shift using our pre-researched lead list

- Use our script and objection-handling guide (full training provided)

- Goal of every call: get permission to send our 2-minute demo video. NOT to close the sale. I close those myself afterward.

- Log every call in a Google Sheet (provided)

- Send a daily 5-minute screen recording with 2-3 actual call recordings and the common objections you heard



REQUIREMENTS:

- Strong, clear English with a neutral or North American accent. This is the most important one. Our customers are tradespeople in the US and Canada who hang up quickly on calls they cannot easily understand.

- 1+ year of B2B cold calling or outbound sales experience

- Experience with VOIP tools (we provide the account)

- Comfortable with Google Sheets and screen recording tools

- Reliable internet, quiet workspace, decent headset

- 5 hours per day, Monday to Friday, 9 PM to 2 AM Manila Time (this is 9 AM to 2 PM Eastern Time, the strongest pickup window for tradespeople in North America)

- B2B outbound experience only. No real estate, insurance, or MLM.



COMPENSATION:

- $3 USD per hour base, paid weekly via Wise or PayPal

- $2 bonus per qualified lead (real business owner, real contact info, agreed to receive the demo)

- $20 bonus per paid customer who signs up from a lead you generated

- $10 retention bonus when that customer stays 60+ days



A solid caller with consistent conversion can land around $5-7 per hour effective rate once the bonuses are factored in.



I'll be straight with you: the base is on the lower end because we're early and bootstrapped. The bonuses are real and they're how I want this role to actually pay. If that math does not work for you, no hard feelings.



HIRE PROCESS:

1. Apply with the items below

2. 15-minute video interview if shortlisted

3. Paid 1-hour live trial ($3) where we run the script together. No free work.

4. 30-day paid probation

5. Long-term ongoing contract



WHAT I PROVIDE:

- Full script and objection-handling guide

- Pre-researched lead list with business info

- VOIP account with a North American number

- Company
 on our domain

- Standard time tracking



HOW TO APPLY:

1. A 60-90 second voice recording introducing yourself and explaining why this role fits you (Vocaroo, SoundCloud, or any audio host works)

2. Your years of B2B cold calling experience and the specific industries you have called into

3. Your typical daily call volume in past roles

4. Your time zone in Manila Time and the shift hours you can work



Applications without a voice recording will not be reviewed. I need to hear how you sound on a call before anything else.



Thanks for reading.



— Asad

title: WordPress SEO Recovery, Site Migration & Ongoing Management
description:
Luxury Pool Builder - Dallas TX area



Who we are

A long time luxury custom pool builder in Frisco Texas. Small WordPress site (~50 pages, 25 blog posts, no e-commerce). Current consultant left a technical mess. We need one person to clean it up, migrate us to a clean independent setup, and manage ongoing SEO performance on a monthly retainer. Long-term relationship if you deliver.



The three phases — in order:

Phase 1 — Technical Fix (Week 1, one-time fixed price)

The site went invisible on Google around February 2026. Zero indexed pages. We know why. We need someone to confirm our diagnosis independently and fix it cleanly.

Specifically:



Look at fixes to previously broken page sitemap, make changes if needed.

Assess current needs for SEO, offer right away solutions and roadmap ideas

Resolve www vs non-www conflict

Clean redirect chain errors

Check and clear UnderConstruction plugin interference

Pull DreamHost server logs and confirm root cause

Block Pakistan bot spam traffic in GA4

Submit priority pages for re-indexing in GSC

Deliver one-page written summary of findings and fixes



Quote this as a fixed price. We expect this to take one experienced person less than a full day.

Phase 2 — Migration & Clean Setup (Week 2, one-time fixed price)

Separate the site completely from the previous consultant's shared agency workspace and move to a clean independent environment.



Specifically:



Transfer all credentials to client-owned accounts — GSC, GA4, WordPress admin, domain registrar, hosting

Assess current DreamHost shared hosting — recommend whether to migrate and to what host

Execute full WordPress migration if recommended — files, database, DNS, zero downtime

Set up clean isolated GA4 property under client-owned Google account

Set up dedicated GSC property verified under client-owned

Verify all redirects, sitemaps, and canonical tags survive migration correctly

Document everything with before and after screenshots



Quote this as a fixed price separate from Phase 1. For a small site with no e-commerce this should be straightforward.

Phase 3 — Ongoing Monthly Management (Retainer starting Month 2)

Small site, simple monthly scope. Client and/or content vendor will produce roughly two new pieces per month — city landing pages, blog posts, FAQ content. Your job is to make sure that content is technically sound, properly indexed, and performing.

Monthly deliverables:



GSC report by 5th of each month — indexed pages, crawl errors, impressions, clicks, top keyword positions

24-hour notification of any new crawl errors or indexing drops

On-page optimization of new content as published

Monthly competitive ranking snapshot vs three named DFW competitors

Quarterly technical audit — sitemaps, redirects, Core Web Vitals

All access held in client name always



What we need from you to apply:



Specific example of a Google indexing failure you diagnosed and fixed — what caused it, what you did, how long it took

Specific example of a WordPress site migration you managed — origin host, destination host, how you handled DNS cutover

Fixed price quote for Phase 1

Fixed price quote for Phase 2

Monthly retainer proposal for Phase 3 with exactly what it includes

Confirmation you manage all client properties in separate isolated Google accounts — not a shared agency workspace

Availability to begin Phase 1 this week



Generic proposals not considered. We have full documentation of the current situation and will ask specific technical questions before hiring.

Budget summary:

Phase 1: $150–$300 fixed

Phase 2: $150–$400 fixed

Phase 3: $??/month ongoing - its a minimal site.. Historically not much to do.



Total first month all-in: X?. Long-term retainer possible.

title: YouTube Video Editor (Educational / Talking Head Content)
description:
# YouTube Video Editor (Educational / Talking Head Content)



## Position Type



Part-Time / Ongoing Contractor



---



## About This Role



We have an existing editor and are building a reliable, long-term team. This is not a desperate replacement gig — we're looking for someone who can grow with the channel, deliver consistently, and become a trusted part of our production workflow.



---



## Compensation



Per-package pricing (no video = no pay):



**Starting Rate (Trial + First Month):**

- $50 per video package

- Includes:

  - 1 long-form YouTube video (5–10 min final runtime)

  - 5–7 short-form vertical clips

  - 1 custom thumbnail



**Scaling Rate (After Proven Consistency):**

- $75–$100 per package after 4–6 successful deliveries

- Based on quality, reliability, and communication



**Additional standalone shorts:**

- $5 each

- $6–$8 if heavier editing or custom graphics required



**Payment Schedule:**

- Every 2 weeks

- Only for packages actually delivered and approved



---



## About The Channel



This channel focuses on:



- mortgages

- real estate

- financial education

- wealth-building concepts



The editing style should feel:



- modern

- clean

- high-retention

- professional

- trustworthy



The goal is NOT gimmicky or overhyped editing.



We want viewers to feel:

*"Clear, calm, confident guidance."*



Style references:



- Graham Stephan

- Ali Abdaal

- Mark Tilbury



---



## What You'll Be Editing



You will primarily edit:



- talking-head educational videos

- financial storytelling content

- mortgage strategy content

- real-world buyer scenarios



Typical long-form videos:



- 5–10 minutes



You will also create:



- YouTube Shorts

- Instagram Reels

- TikTok clips

- LinkedIn vertical clips



---



## Responsibilities



### Long-Form Editing



You will:



- remove mistakes, pauses, filler words

- tighten pacing for retention

- add subtle zoom cuts and jump cuts

- add clean captions and text emphasis

- add occasional b-roll and overlays

- integrate provided infographics and visuals

- use light background music and subtle sound design

- maintain a clean, modern YouTube pacing style



### Short-Form Content



From each long-form video:



- identify strong hook moments

- create 5–7 vertical clips

- format properly for 9:16 platforms

- add captions and pacing optimized for retention

- create clips that drive viewers toward the long-form video



**IMPORTANT:**

Shorts should feel like previews and curiosity-builders — not full summaries.



### Thumbnails



You will create 1 custom thumbnail per long-form video:



- clean, modern design

- clear focal point

- readable text at small sizes

- consistent with channel branding



### Visual / Graphics Work



You may occasionally:



- add simple motion graphics

- integrate charts and infographics

- use stock footage selectively

- organize visuals to improve understanding



Most visuals and scripts will be provided.



---



## Editing Style Requirements



We are looking for editors who understand:



- pacing

- storytelling rhythm

- educational retention

- visual clarity

- modern YouTube editing



This is NOT meme editing.



We prefer:



- clean cinematic pacing

- calm confidence

- modern documentary feel

- clarity over flashy effects



---



## NON-NEGOTIABLES



### Accuracy Matters



This is financial and mortgage content.



All:



- text

- numbers

- names

- graphics

- statistics



MUST match the spoken audio exactly.



Editors who consistently miss details will not be a fit.



### Communication



We value:



- responsiveness

- reliability

- professionalism

- clear communication

- consistency



If deadlines change, communicate early. Silence is the fastest way to lose this role.



### Turnaround Expectations



Typical turnaround:



- 24–48 hours for long-form edit

- Revisions handled quickly



---



## Workflow



Typical workflow:



1. Long-form video delivered first

2. Revisions completed

3. Shorts created from approved final video

4. Thumbnail finalized



We are building:



- templates

- SOPs

- editing systems

- reusable assets



Goal: Create a smooth long-term production workflow.



---



## Included Resources



You will usually receive:



- raw footage

- script

- topic context

- visual references

- infographic assets

- branding direction



---



## Required Skills



- YouTube editing

- Short-form editing

- CapCut or Adobe Premiere Pro

- Understanding of pacing and retention

- Good English comprehension

- Ability to follow detailed instructions

- Basic thumbnail design



Bonus:



- motion graphics

- advanced thumbnail design

- educational content editing

- storytelling instincts



---



## Important Notes



We are looking for:



- long-term relationship

- reliability

- someone who grows with the channel



This role may scale to:



- multiple videos per week

- additional responsibilities

- increased compensation over time based on consistency and quality



---



## Application Requirements



Please include:



1. 2–3 YouTube videos you edited

2. 2–3 short-form videos you edited

3. 1–2 thumbnail examples

4. Your editing software

5. Your turnaround time for a 5–10 minute video

6. Your rate per package (1 long-form + 5–7 shorts + 1 thumbnail)

7. Your internet speed

8. Your 
 or WhatsApp



**IMPORTANT:**

Start your application message with the word:



**"EVEREST"**



---



## Auto-Disqualifiers



We will not consider applicants who:



- Don't include the word "EVEREST" at the start of their message

- Don't include portfolio examples

- Quote rates wildly outside our range without explanation

- Take more than 48 hours to respond during the application process



---



## Trial Process



Selected editors will complete a paid trial edit.



The trial allows both sides to:



- test workflow

- test communication

- test editing style fit

- determine long-term compatibility



We value long-term consistency over short-term speed.

- Monitor daily and weekend operations to ensure all critical tasks, shipments, driver schedules, and event milestones are on track

- Develop and maintain SOPs and process documentation to standardize operations as the business scales

• Identify and implement process improvements to enhance efficiency, cost control, and data accuracy.

title: Operations & Project Manager (Comic Books-Full Time)
description:
Execution Partner-Project Killer-Fast-Growing Comic Book Company



Own the operations backbone of a niche comic book brand, work directly with leadership, and get promoted fairly by numbers. 



- High autonomy: once you’re ramped, you own your queue, schedule, and methods as long as the KPIs are hit. Lots of freedom to figure it out, great for someone that loves building with Legos

- Direct proximity to leadership: you work daily with the Ops Manager on the most important projects in the company.

- Clear advancement path: your growth is tied to visible numbers (tasks shipped, zero-miss cadence, freed founder/ops time, profit/leading metrics), not politics.

- Insane skill growth: the pace and standards here mean every 3 years with us is worth 10 years of experience in a normal VA/ops role. You can leapfrog your peers by being on this team. 

- Comic Books!: you’re not just pushing random SaaS tickets; you’re inside a real comic book store seeing rare old comic books, private deals, and the business behind the Hollywood Marvel Movies that everyone loves!



If you’re that person who enjoys working really hard to the point that it takes 2-3 people to do what you did listen up: 

Our tasks in asana for projects and ongoing operations are moving at a snail’s pace.

Ops Manager + CEO is chasing tasks, slack policing, cleaning up Asana, and re-explaining context instead of focusing on their jobs.



We’ve had “pleasant” VAs who:

Can’t drive tasks to completion independently

Mark tasks complete with no proof

Miss reports/skip cadence and require chasing. 

Drift on ownership, urgency & follow thru

Need hand-holding 



We don’t need another task hopper. Looking for a project killer who comes into ambiguity, creates structure, drives tasks to completion, and actually frees the Ops Manager to focus on his key projects. If this works, his deep work hours and project output go up because you’re handling everything else. We will measure that and tie your promotions/raises to it. This is not for everyone. We’re looking for winners. 



What You’ll Actually Do

You will be Ops Manager’s execution partner and force-multiplier. Concrete outputs:

Own Asana: every task has an owner, due date, Done Check, and proof link when completed

Maintain an active queue of 20+ meaningful tasks, prioritized against our key rocks (Marketing, Sales, Ongoing Operations, Cleanup, Admin)

Ship 25+ tasks/week with proof, minimal rework, and zero “ghosted” items

Proactively handle operational issues/fires in designated lanes

Maintain Reporting at Set Cadence, Follow-up loops across projects

Add leverage: plug AI into our workflows (Asana, docs, reports) to make us faster and cleaner without being asked



We do NOT need more SOPS-although you might tighten them on the fly. We need someone to do the operations. If you want to sit and write playbooks all day, this is the wrong seat-that will be an earned responsibility later. If you aren’t ready to work hard daily do not apply. 



By Day 30: Ops Manager is spending ~95% of his time on projects, not Slack/Asana/admin fires, because you’re handling those and executing projects alongside him. Profit and leading metrics are moving up faster because of you



Who This Is NOT For

You want a chill, low-pressure 9–5

You need to be told what to do all day and hate being judged by objective numbers

You mark tasks complete without proof or next steps

You change jobs every 6–18 months and blame the company/manager/market 

You get defensive or freeze when given direct feedback or pressure



Who This IS For

You’ve stayed 2–3+ years in at least one role and can prove outcomes

You like pressure, highly competitive environments, being the one who “gets it done” when others stall

You’ve built systems (trackers, automations, SOPs), not just followed them

You are tech-comfortable: Asana (or similar), CRMs, zaps, AI tools, simple web/ops/marketing stacks

You’re happy to grind 50–60 hours/week no issues. We’re in a BIG growth & push season. It will be like this for the next year and then we’ll see. Everyone wants to grow a lot, but it’s actually happening here.  



Comp & Growth

title: Experienced WordPress Developer / VA — Custom Website Setup (Health & Wellness Brand)
description:
We're a US-based health and wellness company launching a new website and need an experienced WordPress developer to take our completed website design (fully coded HTML/CSS/JavaScript files) and implement them into a clean, fast, professional WordPress site.

This is NOT a "build from scratch" project. The full website is already designed, coded, and tested — including homepage, product pages, interactive features, cart system, and all content. Your job is to take these files and properly implement them into WordPress using best practices.

This is a project-based role to start. If the setup goes well and you're reliable, there's ongoing work available for site management, updates, content changes, and technical support on a part-time, as-needed basis.



What You'll Be Doing

Phase 1 — WordPress Setup (Main Project)



Install and configure WordPress on our existing hosting

Set up GeneratePress theme (free version)

Create a child theme and build custom page templates from our provided HTML/CSS/JS files

Install and configure required plugins (WPForms, Yoast SEO, Wordfence, WP Fastest Cache, UpdraftPlus, Code Snippets)

Wire up form submissions so cart orders, wholesale inquiries, and
 signups are sent to our business

Set up SSL certificate (HTTPS)

Configure SEO settings (Yoast) for all pages

Ensure the site is fully responsive and looks perfect on mobile, tablet, and desktop

Test all interactive features (product filters, cart drawer, checkout form, modals, popups)

Optimize page load speed (target under 3 seconds)



Phase 2 — Ongoing Support (If Phase 1 Goes Well)



Product updates (new products, purity changes, content edits)

Adding blog posts and content pages

Plugin updates and security monitoring

Site speed optimization

Minor design tweaks and improvements

Troubleshooting any issues that come up





What We'll Provide You



A detailed, step-by-step setup guide with every plugin, setting, and configuration decision already made for you

Three fully coded HTML/CSS/JavaScript website files (homepage, product page template, standalone product page)

All product data, descriptions, and content — nothing for you to write

WordPress admin access

Hosting and domain access as needed

Clear communication and fast responses





Requirements

Must Have:



2+ years of hands-on WordPress experience (not just installing themes — actual custom development)

Experience creating custom page templates and child themes

Solid understanding of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript

Experience with GeneratePress or similar lightweight themes

Familiarity with common plugins: WPForms (or similar), Yoast SEO, caching plugins, security plugins

Ability to take existing HTML files and convert them into proper WordPress templates

Experience with responsive design and mobile optimization

Basic understanding of PHP (for custom functions and form handling)

Reliable internet connection and able to communicate in English

Attention to detail — the design is already pixel-perfect, we need it implemented that way



Nice to Have:



Experience with e-commerce or product catalog websites

Experience with custom JavaScript (cart systems, dynamic content rendering)

Knowledge of Google Analytics and Search Console setup

SEO knowledge beyond basic Yoast configuration

Experience with page speed optimization (Core Web Vitals)





How to Apply

Please DO NOT send a generic application. To show that you've actually read this post, start your application with the answer to this question:

"What is a WordPress child theme and why would we use one instead of editing the parent theme directly?"

Then include:



A brief summary of your WordPress experience (2-3 sentences is fine)

A link to 1-2 WordPress websites you've built or worked on

Your honest assessment of how many hours you think Phase 1 would take

Your hourly rate within the $5-8/hr range

Your availability to start





About Us

We're a small, growing US-based company in the health and wellness space. We value quality, transparency, and attention to detail — in our products and in our website. We're looking for someone reliable, communicative, and skilled who we can build a long-term working relationship with. We pay on time, give clear instructions, and respect your time.

This is a great opportunity if you're looking for a client who knows exactly what they want, provides everything you need to do the job well, and has potential for ongoing work.

title: Social Media, Graphic Design & Marketing VA
description:

We help sales reps and sales managers at some of the top companies in the country perform at their highest level through online coaching programs, a weekly group masterclass, and live bootcamp events.



We are a small, fast-moving remote team. Everyone here owns their lane and executes without being hand-held. We invest in the people on our team and we promote from within when the opportunity exists.



THE ROLE

This is a full-time, long-term position. We are not looking for someone to fill a calendar. We are looking for someone who understands that social media and design exist to build an audience, grow trust, and drive leads — and who can execute at a high level across all three skill areas below.



The right candidate will own our brand visuals, run our social channels consistently, and actively support marketing campaigns that generate real revenue. Over time, this role has a clear path to becoming our full Marketing Lead as we scale.



You will report directly to our founder and work closely with our Sales Director, Operations Manager, and marketing systems team.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN



Graphic Design

Design is the primary skill we are hiring for. If you cannot create clean, on-brand visuals from scratch — not just fill in Canva templates — this role is not for you.



• Create branded graphics for social media posts across
, Instagram, LinkedIn, and YouTube

• Design YouTube thumbnails for weekly coaching session uploads and short-form clips

• Build promotional graphics for webinars, live events, and coaching offers

• Produce formatted training documents and one-pagers for our coaches using Canva and Gamma

• Create event collateral and QR code assets for live bootcamp events

• Maintain visual consistency across all content (we will give you our brand guide on day one)



Social Media Management

You will run our weekly content pipeline end to end: creation, scheduling, moderation, and reporting.



• Plan and schedule 5 posts per week (Monday through Friday) across
, LinkedIn, and YouTube

• Write or co-write captions and one long-form LinkedIn post per week in our brand voice

• Manage our
 Group daily — approve members, moderate posts, and engage with the community

• Live moderate our weekly Wednesday group coaching session (chat, Q&A, questions for the coach)

• Create and schedule guest announcement posts for our weekly masterclass guests

• Repurpose weekly coaching recordings into short-form clips, value posts, and newsletter content

• Manage and update our Google Business Profile

• Track follower growth, engagement metrics, and group membership weekly

• Generate a simple weekly social media report and share it with the team in Slack

• Flag performance issues or engagement drops with context and recommendations — not just data



Marketing Campaign Support

Top Rep runs Meta ad campaigns, webinars, and live bootcamp events that drive new client acquisition. You will support the execution side of these campaigns.



• Create promotional content and graphics for webinar and bootcamp campaigns

• Build on-screen CTA assets and QR codes for use during live webinars

• Draft and send outreach messages to potential podcast guests and influencer partners

• Support sponsor coordination for live events — sponsor page updates, communication, collateral

• Monitor basic campaign performance and flag results to the team

• Create post-event content — recap posts, testimonial graphics, highlight clips

• Manage the YouTube content topic pipeline to support a consistent upload schedule



Admin & Team Operations

• Keep Google Drive content folders organized and up to date

• Maintain posting trackers and content calendars in ClickUp

• Handle masterclass guest logistics — scheduling, pre-event
s, guest list management

• Create and maintain SOPs for your recurring workflows

• Participate in weekly team planning meetings



THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF

• You need daily check-ins or step-by-step instructions to complete recurring work

• You can schedule content but cannot design it from scratch

• You think of social media as just posting — we want someone who thinks about why it works

• You are looking for a short-term or project-based engagement

• You cannot write in natural, clear English — captions and LinkedIn posts are part of the job



REQUIREMENTS

Required

• At least 2 years managing social media for a brand, business, or organization

• Strong Canva skills with a portfolio of original branded work you can show us

• Good written English — you can write copy that sounds human, not templated

• Comfortable working independently in ClickUp or a similar project management tool

• Reliable internet and available to overlap with US Central Time business hours

• Long-term availability — this is a career position, not a side gig



Strong Preference

• Experience with GoHighLevel or similar CRM or funnel platforms

• Experience repurposing video content into short-form clips or reels

• Background supporting a US-based coaching, training, or education company

• Experience moderating live virtual events or webinars

• Experience with Gamma for training or presentation documents

• Familiarity with Meta Ads Manager — even just reading dashboards



WHERE THIS ROLE GOES

We are actively building out our marketing function. Right now we need strong execution. Over time, we want someone who can grow into owning our marketing strategy — campaign planning, content direction, and performance analysis — not just producing assets on request.



If you are someone who wants to grow with a company and eventually lead a function, not just fill a role, this is the opportunity.

 VA

title: Executive Assistant
description:
# Executive & Personal Assistant to Founder



I’m hiring a personal executive assistant to work directly with me and help run the practical parts of my life.



This is a high-trust role. I’m looking for someone who can handle my schedule, travel, appointments, vendors, errands, reservations, events, follow-ups, and the many small things that otherwise sit in my head.



The right person is organized, discreet, loyal, fast, calm, and hard to fluster. You should have good taste, strong judgment, and the ability to figure things out without needing every step explained.



This is not a normal admin job. You will be close to how I operate day to day. You will see personal details, private conversations, family logistics, business matters, and sensitive information. Discretion is required.



## What you’ll handle



You will help with both personal and professional logistics, including:



* Managing my calendar and daily schedule

* Coordinating travel, transportation, hotels, restaurants, and itineraries

* Booking appointments, reservations, dinners, events, and experiences

* Handling errands, purchases, returns, gifting, and personal tasks

* Managing household vendors, service providers, and recurring logistics

* Keeping track of follow-ups, reminders, deadlines, and open loops

* Preparing me for meetings, calls, trips, and events

* Communicating with people on my behalf when needed

* Creating simple systems so things do not fall through the cracks

* Taking on special projects as they come up



Some days will be structured. Some days will change quickly. I need someone who can adapt without getting thrown off.



## What I’m looking for



I’m looking for someone who takes pride in being excellent at the details.



You should be the kind of person who notices when something is slightly off, follows up without being chased, and thinks two steps ahead. You should be comfortable making judgment calls, but also know when something needs to be escalated.



Strong candidates will be:



* Very organized

* Discreet

* Loyal

* Calm under pressure

* Fast to respond

* Good at written communication

* Comfortable around high-performing people

* Comfortable with personal tasks

* Good with vendors, hospitality, scheduling, and logistics

* Detail-oriented without being rigid

* Resourceful when the answer is not obvious



You do not need to have done this exact role before, but you do need to have high standards.



## This role is probably not for you if



* You need a predictable 9-to-5 environment

* You dislike personal errands or lifestyle-related work

* You need every task fully documented before starting

* You are uncomfortable with confidentiality

* You get overwhelmed when plans change

* You are casual about follow-through

* You think “assistant” means waiting to be told what to do



## Compensation and long-term upside



I want this to be a long-term role.



For the right person, compensation will increase meaningfully over time with trust, loyalty, responsibility, and performance. The more useful and dependable you become, the more the role can grow.



I believe in taking care of people who take care of me. If you become someone I can rely on completely, there is no fixed ceiling on where this can go.



This is a role for someone who wants to build real trust over years, not months.



## Ideal background



Helpful experience may include:



* Personal assistant work

* Executive assistant work

* Hospitality

* Private client service

* Family office support

* Founder or entrepreneur support

* Event planning

* Travel coordination

* Household management

* Operations-heavy roles



The most important qualities are judgment, loyalty, discretion, speed, and taste.



## How to apply



Please send:



* A short note about yourself

* Relevant experience

* Where you are based

* Your availability

* A few examples of situations where you had to organize something complex, handle a sensitive matter, or solve a problem without much direction



I care more about quality, trust, and reliability than a perfect resume.

Qualifications

- Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Architecture

- Experience: Minimum of 3 years in architectural/interior design documentation (residential experience preferred; US projects a plus)

- Skills:

s to introduce our products and services.

Follow up with leads and customers to maintain 
ntum and improve conversion opportunities.

Coordinate internally between sales, procurement, and management to support smooth execution after orders are confirmed.



CRM and Pipeline Management

Help management maintain visibility over the sales pipeline and pending opportunities.

Remote Collaboration

Collaborate effectively with management and tea
mbers through virtual meetings and communication tools.

Support cross-functional coordination between procurement, sales, shipping, and operations.

Listen carefully, interpret instructions accurately, and execute tasks efficiently.

Qualifications

Strong knowledge of packaging products, especially flexible packaging and food and beverage packaging, is preferred.

Experience in procurement, sales support, lead generation, customer service, or administrative support.

Experience with cold calling,
 outreach, lead follow-up, or quotation support is a strong asset.

title: Culture & Accountability Operations Lead
description:
Remote | Full-time | 9 AM to 6 PM Eastern (flexible, we care about results, not clocks) | Fluent English required



Salary: $900 to $1,700 USD per month plus performance bonuses.







The Goal of This Role



If you are doing this job well, three things will be true about TopFoxx every single month:



Culture is strong. The team operates with accountability, urgency, professionalism, and respect. People who do not align with our core values are coached, corrected, or offboarded.

Everyone is high performing. Every department has clear KPIs, Rocks, and OKRs that are tracked, owned, and improving month over month.

Systems run the company. There are SOPs, scorecards, and Asana structures for everything, and every SOP has been personally tested by you to confirm a layman could follow it.

That is the job. Culture, performance, systems. Everything else supports those three outcomes.







About TopFoxx



TopFoxx is a rapidly growing, women-owned NYC e-commerce brand creating luxury eyewear with real solutions: floating sunglasses, tangle-free aviators, foldable pocket sunnies, and mood-boosting lenses. We are a small, ambitious, fast-moving team scaling quickly.



Our biggest opportunity right now is not product or marketing, it is culture, accountability, systems, and execution. We need someone who holds the standard daily, builds the structure that lets A-players thrive, and surfaces and offboards anyone not aligned with our core values.







Core Mission



Protect, reinforce, and operationalize our culture, standards, accountability, urgency, professionalism, and execution consistency. You are the holder of the standard, every day, across the whole company.



This is not a punishing role, it is a reinforcing and rewarding one. You catch people doing it right, praise them publicly, build incentives that reinforce the behaviors we want, and address misalignment quickly and directly. You are how we keep A-players happy and how we make sure we only have A-players.







The Stack You'll Run



You must be highly fluent in:



Asana (you are the guardian of Asana)

Slack (team communication and real-time culture monitoring)

Shopify (our e-commerce backbone)

Google Drive, Sheets, and Loom (documentation and SOPs)

AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT, with the judgment to know the difference between a real, tested SOP and "AI slop" nobody can actually follow

We expect you to leverage AI to move faster, but to personally pressure-test every output before it ships.



EOS / Traction experience is highly preferred. You should already be fluent in Rocks, KPIs, scorecards, OKRs, L10 meetings, and accountability rhythms.







Key Responsibilities



1. Culture and Accountability (The Main Job)



Be highly active in Slack, Asana, meetings, and team workflows, monitoring communication, behavior, professionalism, and collaboration.

Address issues immediately when standards are crossed. Pull people into quick 5-minute calls to correct behavior or clarify expectations.

Prevent negativity, gossip, blame-shifting, passive aggression, or poor communication from spreading culturally.

Catch and stop "AI slop" in the team's work, sloppy AI-generated outputs that have not been verified or thought through.

Document concrete, evidence-based examples of both positive and negative behavior tied to our core values. No vague feedback.

Use this documentation for coaching, promotions, reviews, warnings, and determining long-term fit.





2. Positive Reinforcement, Rewards, and Incentive Programs



Publicly recognize employees who demonstrate ownership, urgency, preparation, communication, and professionalism.

Run a steady cadence of small incentives (Amazon gift cards, shoutouts, peer recognition) for exceptional execution.

Design and run structured incentive and commission programs for revenue-driving roles (sales, wholesale, paid media, retention), tying rewards directly to outcomes that move the business.





3. KPI, Rocks, and OKR Ownership



You will not just tell people how they are doing, you will go in and check.



Shadow each department to understand what people actually do day to day.

Build KPI scorecards, quarterly Rocks, and OKRs for every department and role, with measurable weekly targets.

Run check-ins, identify bottlenecks, fix root causes, and improve KPIs month over month.

Our business is complicated with many moving parts. You will need to dig in to fully understand each role before setting standards for it.





4. Systems, SOPs, and Documentation (Quality-Controlled)



Build TopFoxx's operating backbone from the ground up: clear SOPs, step-by-step playbooks, and Loom videos for every recurring process.

Standardize folder structures, naming conventions, and templates in Google Drive.

Personally test every SOP. Walk through it yourself end to end as if you were a new hire. If a layman cannot follow it without asking questions, it is not done. No AI slop, no theoretical playbooks, no "close enough."

Re-test SOPs regularly. A stale SOP is worse than no SOP.





5. Coaching Leaders and Managers



Several people on our team are extremely talented in their craft but have never managed direct reports before. You will help build them into great managers.



Coach team leads on how to actually manage: setting expectations, giving direct feedback, running 1:1s, holding people accountable, and developing them.

Help managers raise the bar of the people they lead, not just delegate tasks.

Sit in on tough conversations and model what a direct, professional, accountable conversation looks like.

Identify when a manager is the bottleneck and coach them through it, or escalate to the Founder if the gap is too large.

Build a simple internal playbook for "how we manage at TopFoxx."





6. Onboarding, 1:1s, and Career Growth



You own how people are developed at TopFoxx, from day one through every stage of their career here.



Run onboarding for every new hire: be present every day for the first 5 days, then check in twice a week for the next few weeks, then settle into a weekly cadence.

Build a job scorecard for every role that defines what success looks like, what the KPIs are, and what "great" means at each level.

Build a career growth plan for every tea
mber that maps where they are now, where they could go, and what they need to develop to get there.

Hold weekly 1:1s with tea
mbers to check in on progress, blockers, wins, and growth.

Make development concrete, not theoretical. Every person should know exactly what they are working on, what they are being measured on, and what their next step looks like.





7. Asana and Project Management



Clean up and restructure workflows, create consistent naming conventions, and build repeatable project templates.

Ensure every task has clear ownership and a deadline.

Create tasks, follow-ups, reminders, and accountability checkpoints. Reinforce review timelines, urgency standards, and deadline ownership.





8. Interpersonal Conflict Resolution



Address tension, confusion, or recurring friction between tea
mbers early before it damages culture or performance.

Coach people toward direct, mature, solution-oriented communication.





9. Culture Presentations and Team Development



Create presentations, trainings, and workshops around our values and standards.

Continuously teach the team what "great" looks like operationally and behaviorally, reinforced through real examples and coaching.





10. Hiring, Vetting, and Talent Quality



Conduct structured interviews that test judgment, ownership, and real execution ability.

Check references thoroughly with hard, specific questions about reliability, speed, and integrity. Validate real past results, not buzzwords.

Assess cultural fit against TopFoxx values of accountability, urgency, and clarity.

Recommend final candidates to the Founder with clear, evidence-based rationale.





11. Operations Support and Role Backfill



While culture, KPIs, and systems are your main focus, you will also help where the business needs it, including temporarily stepping into vacated roles so things do not fall apart while we hire a replacement.



Be ready to absorb a vacated role short-term (customer service, ops support, project coordination).

Structure workflows across Customer Service, Fulfillment, and Vendors. Create checklists for inventory and orders.

Build Google Sheets trackers and handle general assistant tasks and project management for the Founder when required.





12. Reporting and Leadership Visibility



Provide leadership with recurring reports on:



Cultural health, team accountability, and communication quality.

Strong performers, team risks, operational bottlenecks, and alignment with core values.

KPI, Rock, and OKR progress across every department, month over month.

Manager development progress: who is growing into a strong leader, who is stuck.





What We're Looking For



5+ years in operations, project management, performance management, or systems building, with direct experience holding teams accountable and driving culture, not just managing tasks.

Experience coaching first-time managers into strong leaders.

Experience building KPI scorecards, Rocks, OKRs, and career growth plans that drove measurable improvement month over month.

Experience creating SOPs and playbooks that people actually use day to day.

Strong command of Asana, Slack, Shopify, Google Drive, Sheets, and Loom.

Strong AI fluency (Claude, ChatGPT) and judgment to know when an AI output is good vs "slop."

Excellent persuasive written and verbal English. You will be coaching, presenting, and writing for the whole team.

Comfortable having direct conversations when standards slip, without being harsh or political.

Startup or fast-growing small business experience preferred. E-commerce is a strong plus.

EOS / Traction experience (Rocks, KPIs, scorecards, OKRs, L10s) is highly preferred since this is the system we are implementing.





What You Get



$900 to $1,700 USD per month plus performance-based bonuses, based on experience.

Fully remote with flexible hours around 9 AM to 6 PM Eastern.

Direct access to the Founder and leadership team.

Opportunity to grow into senior leadership as we scale.

Free TopFoxx products. Paid time off.

title: Sales Manager
description:
Record Label Music & Sales Manager (Remote)



Pex Life Records LLC: Our Vision for Transformative Music



Pex Life Records is an independent label where urban music meets personal development. Founded by Wilmarck, we create high-quality tracks that resonate with the motivation of Tony Robbins, blended with the commercial sound of artists like Kanye West and Drake. Our music is purpose-driven, focusing on critical life areas: health, financial literacy, peak performance, and spirituality.



You will be joining a brand with a strong, engaged audience of over 1,000
 subscribers and 20,
 followers. Your work will directly contribute to inspiring and uplifting thousands through music.-----The Role: Drive Revenue, Build a Team, Shape a Brand



We are seeking a highly motivated Music Manager to lead our sales, operations, and team development. This is a pivotal role for a professional ready to commit to a 45-50 hour/week position that offers substantial commission potential and a clear path to high earnings.



Key Areas of Impact:

Sales & Business Development: Lead client acquisition by pitching proposals to songwriting job boards and driving profits to achieve ambitious sales targets.

Team Leadership: Recruit, hire, train, and inspire contractors and staff to ensure stellar performance and successful new releases.

Operations & Finance: Manage contracts, maintain essential financial records (bookkeeping), and ensure compliance and seamless communication across all stakeholders.

Customer Experience: Be the face of the company, creating memorable customer experiences, explaining product/service prices, and handling key inquiries.



Compensation & Uncapped Earning Potential



This is a performance-driven role with a clear path to significant monthly income through our incentive program.

Base & Growth: The hourly rate starts at $2.81 USD plus commission. The initial 10 hours/week commitment quickly scales up to 45 hours/week within 45 days, allowing for a rapid increase in base earnings.

Monthly Compensation Range: $505–$900 Guaranteed Base + Generous Commission.



Compensation Structure by Target Revenue Goal:

Achieve $1,200 Minimum: Guaranteed Monthly Base: $675 Minimum. Commission Rate: 10% on qualifying sales. Enhanced Benefits Package: 13th Month Pay, Internet Costs Reimbursement, Profit Sharing, PhilHealth Reimbursement.

Achieve $2,400 Minimum: Guaranteed Monthly Base: $900 Minimum. Commission Rate: 15% on qualifying sales. Enhanced Benefits Package: Social Security System & Pag-IBIG Fund Reimbursement, 50% HMO Expenses, Profit Sharing.



Flexibility and Structure:



100% Remote Position: Work from anywhere.

Core Availability: Sunday–Thursday, 6:30 PM EST – 3:00 AM EST.

Work/Life Balance: We offer Flexible Scheduling (choose your working days/hours) and Job Sharing options.

Prospect Response Disclaimer: Maintain key client relationships by being available for 3-5 quick, 5–15 minute responses per week within a designated 8-hour window (e.g., 3:00 PM – 11:00 PM EST).



What We're Looking For (Skills & Qualities)



We need a relentless executor with an independent spirit and high integrity.

Essential: Superior proposal writing, persistence, time management, and strong English speaking/writing skills.

Ideal Candidate: Flexible, eager to learn, competitive, and receptive to constructive criticism.



Your Path to Full-Time: The Paid Audition



We skip the traditional hiring steps and go straight to evaluating your work. The process is designed to be fair, fast, and merit-based:

1 Submit your proposal.

2 Pass a screening exercise.

3 Participate in an interview.

4 Top candidates are selected for a paid audition to ensure a mutual fit before a full-time offer is extended.

If you are ready to be a crucial leader in a high-growth, mission-driven music company, apply now!



Application Instructions:



Demonstrate your expertise in sales management (client acquisition, appointment setting, and closing calls) in your proposal. To ensure you've read these details, please begin your proposal with the phrase "purple elephant."

title: Shopify Designer / Developer
description:
Job Description: Shopify Designer / Developer



Location: Remote (WFH)



Type: Project-Based (Hourly) (Ideally available up to 30+ hours a week until project is completed. Starting at 2 websites a month then growing after you prove yourself.)



Confidentiality: High (Non-Disclosure Agreement Required)







Role Overview

We're looking for a Shopify Designer/Developer to build author websites for our publishing client's growing roster. Each site will be designed from an existing brand kit produced by our design team — your job is to translate that identity into a clean, professional Shopify storefront optimized for selling books directly to readers. This is a project-based role paid on an hourly basis with ongoing volume as the client scales. Due to the sensitive nature of the work, a signed NDA is mandatory.







Key Responsibilities



Site Builds: Build and launch author websites on Shopify, customized to match provided brand guidelines.



Theme Customization: Customize Shopify themes to align with each author's visual identity.



E-Commerce Setup: Set up product listings, collections, and book sales flows.



Mobile Optimization: Ensure all sites are fully responsive and load quickly across devices.



App Integration: Integrate apps as needed —
 capture, social links, review widgets, etc.



Handoff: Deliver clean, documented sites so authors can manage their own content going forward.



Remote Coordination: Work independently and stay in sync with our PM and design team via Slack.







Compensation & Work Structure



Hourly Pay: Compensation is calculated on an hourly basis for the duration of the project.



Project-Based: Engagement occurs on a per-project basis with clear delivery milestones.



Flexible Remote Work: Work from your own space while coordinating with an international team.







Required Skills & Qualifications



Shopify Experience: Proven experience building and customizing Shopify stores — portfolio of live stores required.



Theme Customization: Ability to customize Shopify themes; Liquid knowledge is a strong plus.



Design Eye: Able to translate a brand kit into a cohesive, polished site — not just install a template.



E-Commerce UX: Solid understanding of e-commerce UX and product page best practices.



Remote Setup: Access to a high-performance computer and a reliable internet connection.



Discretion: Total commitment to maintaining confidentiality and protecting client data.







Nice To Have



Experience with Shopify apps like Klaviyo, Loox, or ReConvert



Basic SEO knowledge for product and page titles



Experience with author or book-related e-commerce
